scenario.title: 推薦歌手、比較專輯、去演唱會
scenario.context: 聊音樂一定會比較：這張比上一張好、這是他最棒的歌、現場比錄音更好聽。比較級和最高級看起來簡單，但 more better、the most best 這類錯誤在台灣人的英文裡非常常見。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Who's in charge of music? Please not Minz. Her playlist is the saddest thing I've ever heard.
lines.zh: 誰負責放音樂？拜託不要 Minz，她的歌單是我聽過最悲傷的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hey! It's not sad, it's chill.

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I'll do it. Have you heard the new Sunset Rollercoaster album?
lines.zh: 我來。你們聽過落日飛車的新專輯了嗎？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Yeah, but I think their older stuff is better.
lines.zh: 聽過，但我覺得他們以前的作品比較好。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Really? The new one is way more polished.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Play track four. That song slaps.

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Agreed. It's the catchiest song on the album.
lines.zh: 同意，那是整張專輯最洗腦的一首。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: OK, fine, it's a banger. Turn it up!

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That was the best concert I've been to in years.
lines.zh: 那是我這幾年去過最棒的演唱會。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: They sounded even better live than on the record.
lines.zh: 他們現場聽起來甚至比錄音更好。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: And the crowd was so much louder than last time.
lines.zh: 而且觀眾比上次吵多了。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: The encore was my favorite part. They played that old song from 2012!
lines.zh: 安可是我最喜歡的部分，他們唱了 2012 年那首老歌！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Everyone thought they were a one-hit wonder back then.
lines.zh: 那時候大家都以為他們只會紅一首。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: And now they're one of the most popular bands in Asia.
lines.zh: 現在他們是亞洲最受歡迎的樂團之一。

chinglish.right: This song is better. / This song is much better.
chinglish.why: better 本身就是比較級，不能再加 more。要加強用 much / way / even。

chinglish.wrong: She is the most best singer.
This album is more popular than any album.
chinglish.right: This album is more popular than any other album.
chinglish.why: 跟同類比較時要加 other，不然等於拿自己跟自己比。
「洗腦」直翻 brainwashing 是「政治洗腦」。歌很洗腦用 catchy。

grammar.title: 比較級與最高級
grammar.oneLiner: 短形容詞加 -er / -est，長形容詞用 more / most；better、best 這種不規則的不要再加 more。
whenToUse: 一音節：old → older → the oldest；big → bigger → the biggest。
-y 結尾的兩音節：catchy → catchier → the catchiest。
兩音節以上：popular → more popular → the most popular。
不規則：good → better → best；bad → worse → worst；far → farther / further。
加強比較級：much / way / a lot / even better。（不用 very better）
最高級常搭配：the best … I've ever…、one of the most…、in the world / on the album。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文比較只要加「比較」「更」「最」，詞本身不變，所以台灣人很自然地把 more 加在 better 前面，或者說 very better（中文「好很多」）。另外中文的「更好」「最好」一樣是 better 和 best，但學習者常忘記它們是不規則變化。

examples.correct: Their new album is way better than the last one.
examples.incorrect: Their new album is very more better than the last one.
examples.note: 用 way / much 加強比較級。

examples.correct: It's the catchiest song of the year.
She's one of the most talented singers in Taiwan.
examples.note: one of the most + 複數名詞。

examples.correct: The concert was worse than I expected.
examples.incorrect: The concert was more bad than I expected.

examples.correct: That's the best concert I've ever been to.
examples.note: 最高級 + I've ever… 很常見。

quiz.explanation: much better；better 不加 more、不用 very。

slang.usage: 形容讓人想跟著搖擺的好歌。英式口語 banger 也可以指香腸。

risk.note: 年輕人常用，大人說會有點「裝年輕」的可愛感。

examples.en: Every song on this album is a banger.
examples.zh: 這張專輯每首都是神曲。

examples.en: Put on some bangers for the party.

slang.usage: This song slaps. 也可以形容食物：This beef noodle soup slaps.

risk.note: Gen Z 用語，三十歲以上的人用會顯得刻意；正式場合不用。聽得懂最重要。

examples.en: Have you heard this remix? It slaps.
examples.zh: 你聽過這個混音嗎？超讚。

slang.usage: 只有一首成名曲、之後就沒消息的藝人；也可引申到其他領域。

risk.note: 帶點調侃，但是常見說法。

examples.en: Most people think they're a one-hit wonder, but their other songs are great.
examples.zh: 大部分人以為他們只紅一首，但其他歌也很棒。

examples.en: I don't want my startup to be a one-hit wonder.
examples.zh: 我不想讓我的新創只紅一次。

slang.usage: This is my jam! = 這是我的愛歌！動詞 jam = 一起即興玩音樂。

examples.en: Oh, turn it up! This is my jam!
examples.zh: 喔，開大聲！這是我的愛歌！

examples.en: We jammed in his garage every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期天都在他車庫即興玩音樂。

review.question: By the time we arrived, the band ___ playing.
review.explanation: 複習第 32 單元：先發生的用過去完成式。

review.question: She's the singer ___ song went viral last year.
They're playing tonight, ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 29 單元：they're → aren't they。

review.question: Can you turn the music ___? I can't hear you. (關小聲)
review.explanation: 複習第 25 單元片語動詞：turn down = 調小聲。

review.question: The concert starts in ten minutes. We ___ hurry.
Which is correct?
review.explanation: 比較級用 way / much 加強。
